secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL required for database-backed app features.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Server-only Supabase secret key. Keep private; never add a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix or commit it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Legacy alternative to SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY for server-side database access; keep private.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack secret key for live payments (sk_live_... or sk_test_...). Optional; the app uses demo mode without it. Set in the host secrets store, never in git.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYSTACK_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key for live checkout (pk_live_... or pk_test_...). Optional; set both Paystack keys as a matching pair, or leave both unset for demo mode.

secrets.name: FOOTBALL_API_KEY
secrets.description: football-data.org API key for live fixture data. Optional — app falls back to seed data without it.

secrets.name: AFFILIATE_URL_TEMPLATE
secrets.description: Template for tracked affiliate links in odds comparison. Optional.

secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the session cookie (HS256). Optional — a dev secret is used if unset.
